text: vadāmīti . sattamaṃ . [20] yo bhikkhave rūpe abhinandati dukkhaṃ so abhinandati . yo dukkhaṃ abhinandati aparimutto so dukkhasmāti vadāmi .pe. yo sadde gandhe rase phoṭṭhabbe dhamme abhinandati dukkhaṃ so abhinandati . yo dukkhaṃ abhinandati aparimutto so dukkhasmāti vadāmi . yo ca kho bhikkhave rūpe nābhinandati dukkhaṃ so nābhinandati . yo dukkhaṃ nābhinandati parimutto so dukkhasmāti vadāmi . yo sadde gandhe rase phoṭṭhabbe dhamme nābhinandati dukkhaṃ so nābhinandati . yo dukkhaṃ nābhinandati parimutto so dukkhasmāti vadāmīti . aṭṭhamaṃ . [21] yo bhikkhave cakkhussa
